A solid weeknight go-to: **One-Pan Lemon-Garlic Chicken with Broccoli & Rice**

**Ingredients (2 servings)**
- 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts (or thighs)
- 1 large head broccoli, cut into florets
- 1 cup jasmine or basmati rice
- 3 tbsp butter, divided
- 3 garlic cloves, minced
- Zest & juice of 1 lemon
- ½ cup chicken broth (or water + bouillon)
- Salt, pepper, pinch of red-pepper flakes
- Optional: parsley or basil for garnish

**Method (≈25 min)**
1. Start rice per package directions (15 min simmer, 5 min rest).
2. While rice cooks, pound chicken to even ½-inch thickness; season.
3. Large skillet, 1 tbsp butter over med-high. Sear chicken 3–4 min/side until golden & 165 °F. Remove.
4. Same pan, add 1 tbsp butter + broccoli + pinch salt. Sauté 3 min, splash 2 tbsp water, cover 2 min until bright-green tender.
5. Push broccoli aside, add last tbsp butter + garlic; 30 s. Stir in lemon zest, juice, broth; bubble 1 min.
6. Return chicken (and any juices) to pan, spoon sauce over, heat 30 s.
7. Plate rice, top with chicken & broccoli, drizzle pan sauce, garnish.

**Why it works**: one pan, minimal chop, cooks while rice simmers, bright flavor without heavy cream or long marinades.
